first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: The only running person in this clip, with short dark hair, a dark short-sleeved top, and white shorts. Before the cut, Person A is seen from behind from a high rear position; at local frame 23, the shot cuts to a low frontal view, and this is still the same person.

entities.name: passageway surface
entities.identification: The central passage surface along which Person A travels, paved with light gray panels featuring fine grooves, seams, and dot-like holes, continuously curving into the depth of the image.

entities.name: bulkhead
entities.identification: The light gray-white enclosing walls on both sides of the passageway, featuring panel seams, dark rectangular openings, and built-in facilities.

entities.name: curved structure
entities.identification: The set of large, light-colored arc-shaped components at the upper image-left and image-right, with clearly defined multilayered inner and outer contours.

entities.name: light strip
entities.identification: The continuous blue-white luminous strips arranged along the outer edges of the curved structures and the adjacent bulkheads; the set does not include the small buttons on the control panels.

entities.name: seat
entities.identification: The set of dark seats on both sides of the passageway, including visible backrests, headrests, and parts of seat cushions; a headrest is not a second person.

entities.name: desktop
entities.identification: The set of light-colored flat desktops adjacent to the side seats and projecting from the bulkheads; this does not include the passageway surface beneath Person A's feet.

entities.name: control panel
entities.identification: The set of dark rectangular panels on the bulkheads, beside the desktops, and along the edges of recesses, with visible groups of bright-colored buttons, indicator areas, or screens.

entities.name: wall niche
entities.identification: The set of bright recessed spaces in the side walls, with white interior walls, rectangular lights, and partial countertops; no inference that these are compartment doors currently opening or closing is required.

entities.name: bulkhead recess
entities.identification: The set of vertically elongated, round-cornered recesses visible on both sides behind Person A in the latter half of this clip; inside the dark outer edges are elongated light blue-gray inner surfaces, some with light-colored horizontal sections at the top, and small control panels near the edges.
